step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify visual nodes from whiteboard: 'AWS' (decomposed per Rule 4 into CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SQS, and SNS based on audio context), 'ON-PREM' (OnPremDC), 'APACHE METRON' (ThirdParty), 'SECURITY DATA LAKE' containing 'EMR', 'S3', and 'ATHENA', 'SOAR' (ThirdParty), 'ALERTS' (UserCompanyAnalyst), and 'WAF' (WAF).
2. Trace connections: AWS services and ON-PREM push telemetry data to APACHE METRON. APACHE METRON streams persistent data into the EMR job inside the Security Data Lake, which writes transformed data to S3, queried by ATHENA. A feedback loop arrow goes from S3 back to APACHE METRON for long-term profiling/enrichment. On the real-time response side, APACHE METRON sends alerts to SOAR, which notifies SOC Analysts (ALERTS), who then execute mitigation actions via WAF.
